title: Operators
description: Staff who create orders on behalf of {{market}} and their commission
descriptionFallback: Staff who create orders on behalf of your store and their commission

list.label: Operator list
list.emptyDescription: An operator creates orders on behalf of {{market}}. Add one and set a commission — earnings are recorded for every sold order.
list.emptyDescriptionFallback: An operator creates orders on behalf of your store. Add one and set a commission — earnings are recorded for every sold order.
list.notFoundDescription: Change the search or the status filter.

warning.singleTitle: Commission not set — no earnings recorded
warning.singleText: No earnings are recorded for orders sold by {{name}}. Set a commission.
warning.manyTitle: {{count}} operators have no commission — no earnings recorded
warning.manyText: No earnings are recorded for orders sold by {{names}}. Set a commission for each.

commissionForm.percentHint: 0 to 100, up to 2 decimals. Taken from the sold order price.

create.title: Add operator
create.descriptionFallback: New staff member for your store
create.name: Full name
create.passwordHint: At least 6 characters: 1 uppercase letter, 1 lowercase letter and 1 digit. Simple, sequential passwords and the phone number are not accepted. The operator signs in with this phone and password.
create.percentHint: Of the sold order price, 0 to 100. Leave it empty to set later — until then no earnings are recorded.
create.fixedHint: Per sold order, 0 to {{max}}. Leave it empty to set later — until then no earnings are recorded.

errors.phoneTaken: This phone number is taken — enter another one
errors.passwordShort: Password must be at least 6 characters
errors.passwordSpaces: The password must not start or end with a space
errors.passwordLong: The password is too long — 72 characters at most
errors.passwordUpper: The password must contain at least 1 uppercase letter
errors.passwordLower: The password must contain at least 1 lowercase letter
errors.passwordDigit: The password must contain at least 1 digit

create.failedText: Check the details and try again.
create.blocked: The store is blocked — operators can't be added
create.createdText: {{name}} can now sign in with this phone and password.
create.commissionFailedText: Set the commission for {{name}} again — until then no earnings are recorded.

commissionDialog.title: Commission
commissionDialog.unsetTitle: Commission not set — no earnings recorded
commissionDialog.unsetText: No earnings are recorded for this operator's sales right now.
commissionDialog.sampleTextEmpty: From a sold order of <nw>{{price}}</nw> — enter a percentage
commissionDialog.howText: A fixed amount doesn't depend on the order price: a sold order of <nw>{{low}}</nw> and one of <nw>{{high}}</nw> earn the same amount.
commissionDialog.note: The new rate applies only to future sales — past earnings don't change.
commissionDialog.notFound: Operator not found — the list was refreshed

removeConfirm.title: Remove the commission?
removeConfirm.description: No earnings will be recorded for future sales. Past earnings are kept.
removeConfirm.failed: Couldn't remove the commission. Please try again.

deleteDialog.title: Delete operator
deleteDialog.note: They will no longer be able to sign in. Their orders and earnings history are kept.
deleteDialog.failed: Couldn't delete the operator. Please try again.
deleteDialog.notFound: Operator not found — it may have been deleted already.

warehouseAccess.label: Sees warehouse stock
warehouseAccess.failed: The switch kept its previous position. Please try again.
warehouseAccess.notFound: Operator not found — the list was refreshed.

payments.description: Payments you made to {{market}} operators — does not affect the Elchi cashbox
payments.descriptionFallback: Payments you made to operators — does not affect the Elchi cashbox

balances.title: Balance per operator
balances.description: Balance = earned − paid. A negative balance means overpaid.
balances.label: Operator balances
balances.emptyDescription: Add an operator — their earnings and payments will appear here.

history.title: Payment history
history.description: Payments recorded to operators, newest first
history.label: Payment history
history.elchiHint: Paid earlier by Elchi — cannot be cancelled
history.emptyDescription: When you pay an operator, record it here — the balance goes down automatically.
history.notFoundDescription: Pick another operator or clear the filter.

form.title: Record payment
form.description: Record the money you gave to an operator
form.notice: Does not affect the Elchi cashbox — this only records a payment you made to the operator yourself.
form.amountOver: {{amount}} more than the balance — will be recorded as an overpayment

errors.dateFuture: A future date cannot be selected

confirm.title: Confirm the payment
confirm.description: Does not affect the Elchi cashbox: this entry only records money you gave to the operator yourself.
confirm.hint: If the entry is wrong, you can cancel it later with a reason.
confirm.conflict: This payment may already be recorded with different details — close the dialog and check the history.
confirm.notFound: Operator not found — refresh the list.
confirm.failed: Could not record the payment. Please try again.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel payment entry
cancelDialog.note: The entry is not deleted: it stays in the history as “Cancelled” and is not counted in “Paid”.
cancelDialog.notFound: Payment not found — the list was refreshed.
cancelDialog.legacy: This payment was made from the Elchi cashbox — it cannot be cancelled.
cancelDialog.failed: Could not cancel. Please try again.
